introduce:
Sit on a chair. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Hinge forward from the hips, using your left hand to push your knee down toward the ground. 

Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair. 

Tuck your chin, and round your back as you exhale. Then take a breath in, and look up, trying to drive your chest out. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR CAT COW

tips.text: Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.
You should not feel tenseness in your shoulders or back.
This exercise works on your upper back and helps stretch your spine.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor.

Put your left hand on your back and reach down as far as you can. Use your right hand to grab your left elbow.

Bend your upper body to the right. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR TRICEPS SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Take deeper stretches with every breath.
You can feel your triceps, obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce:

name: CHAIR TRICEPS SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Take deeper stretches with every breath.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs hip-with apart and your feet flat on the floor.

Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back. 

Fold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your back straight and cross your right leg over your left. 

Slowly twist your body to the right as much as possible with your gaze over your right shoulder.

Press your left hand against the outside of your right knee to deepen the twist and place your right hand on the chair behind you for support.

Hold this position.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST LEGS CROSSED RIGHT

tips.text: Let your head follow the movement of your body.
This exercise helps increase spinal flexibility and relax back muscles.
